request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"Fashion Club is putting on the Runway Show, where student designers present their own collections. It is for students who design, sew and style, and for classmates who want to see what their peers have made. Fabric and sewing supplies would matter a great deal to the designers, because materials are what let them turn sketches into finished pieces they are proud to show. Help with supplies means more students can bring their full vision to the runway, and everyone who comes gets to see that work up close. We would be glad to tell you more about the show and the students behind it.","contains_instructions":false}
